question: Can the original charged fermionic Gamma NS/R sectors and their odd-field response be reconstructed from the fixed even neighbor L_h with inherited charges, parity, and assigned time?
summary_de: Bedingte Viersektoren-Rekonstruktion des urspruenglichen Gamma-NS/R-Randraums aus dem geraden Nachbarn L_h: eta-Twist, f+L_h, Arf-/S-Vorzeichen, Gamma-Cocycle und 0<->f sowie h<->h+f Intertwiner reproduzieren die geladenen Feldantworten unter einem gemeinsam vorgegebenen Hamiltonian. Die Konstruktion waehlt weder L_h noch V_c und leitet weder native Quelle noch Hamiltonoperator oder physische T1-T8-Gates her.
assumptions: Fixed rank-ten lattice dictionary, its Gamma0 gluing, inherited vertex cocycles and compact 9R/1L field quantization
A common sector-preserving Hamiltonian/domain exists on all four modules and the original odd intertwiners are retained
Standard eta-twisted lattice-module construction and the selected Arf/spin convention
Interacting trace identities require a common regulated or self-adjoint realization
kills: Treat four partition traces without intertwiners as a fermion reconstruction
Treat the twisted sector as a new native source or a local field of the full T(E8) extension
Infer V_c, a cosine coefficient, an RG flow, or a physical vacuum from sector closure
Claim that QHP=0 prevents a charged field response when Q V_x P is nonzero
leaves_open: Native finite-source operator, state and time map into the four-sector continuum construction
Source selection of the even neighbor, spin structure, V_c or any interaction coefficient
Physical flux/gauge interpretation and all T1-T8 closures
A complete 3+1D dynamics and anomaly/gravitation derivation
not_claimed: No new Hamiltonian or physical gate is introduced
No claim that odd Gamma fields are mutually local with every T(E8) current
Finite exact controls are not a proof-assistant formalization or empirical evidence

source_pins.role: fixed charged-lift lattice and even-neighbor input
finite twist and conditional charged-field boundary
